The '''abandoned Rakata machine chamber''' was one of the ice caverns that made up [[the Tomb]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]. Located in the southwestern corner of the Tomb, it drew its name from the large [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] machine that lay, partially damaged, in the center of the chamber. The [[Automated Checkpoint]], manned by still-functioning Rakatan [[Droid/Legends|droids]], was located in the chamber, as were several vaults&mdash;the [[power relay vault]], a [[Esh-kha interrogation chamber|chamber]] used by the [[Esh-kha]] for interrogation, and another [[Esh-kha warrior barracks|chamber]] used as barracks for their warriors. A [[Lower Transport Center|transporter]] was located in a small cave off the main cavern.<ref name="TOR" />
